annotations.title: Nominations: close suggestions and start voting with the finalists

description: Nominations: close suggestions and start voting with the finalists Body: { finalists?: [post ids] }. Without finalists, every approved suggestion goes on; with them, only those (a waiting one is approved). The finalists become the entries, the rest are hidden, and voting opens. Can't be undone. Needs the organizer key.
